ambient.name: Restless Explorer
ambient.description: Prefers nearby unfamiliar space, pauses for novel Oil, tires of repeated discoveries and eventually returns home. High activity depletes its exploration cycle quickly.

ambient.name: Homebody Keeper
ambient.description: Takes short local trips, inspects new material without long pursuits and spends finite intervals back at home. Editable activity regions can give it a favourite workplace.

ambient.name: Persistent Scavenger
ambient.description: Investigates Oil, remembers useful patches, revisits them after a delay and searches briefly after losing sight of them. It tolerates more failed approaches but must eventually withdraw.

ambient.name: Territorial Watcher
ambient.description: Keeps near its home, briefly watches passing compatible peers and retreats from disliked tags. Add an interest region to give it an authored activity area.

ambient.name: Cautious Flyer
ambient.description: For supported two-axis 4LY rigs. It explores slowly, inspects new Oil, uses observed eight-direction clearance, rests on actual low energy and returns home when its exploration cycle declines.

ambient.name: Boundary Grazer
ambient.description: For supported two-axis 4LY rigs. Follows an actually sampled Oil boundary tangent, remembers interesting patches, and occasionally leaves the edge for a seeded excursion.
